roadmap.description: Play through all five story chapters (60-80 hours) and finish the final mission. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends, and save manually at the start and end of every chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave; there is no mission replay, so chapter saves are the only safety net). All 12 story trophies land here, and story progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.
roadmap.title: Story + Chapter 1 meditation
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

roadmap.description: Finish the stranger questlines: Andy (Lucia, Chapter 3), Kenton (Chapter 1), Billy (Chapter 2), Randy (Chapter 3), Tyrone (Jason, Chapter 3) and Bret (Jason, Chapter 2), plus 8 counted Strangers & Freaks strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete). All of these stay available after the story ends.
roadmap.title: Stranger questlines

roadmap.description: Partner crimes and combat: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob three shops back to back, land 5 kills in one Combat Focus, steal a plane at VCIA, steal a Rhino tank, and finish the two newly solved mystery trophies (the Payday Loans re-robbery and the UFO abduction). Ten Pin is attempted here too, but its method is still unverified.
roadmap.title: Partner crimes & mysteries

roadmap.description: Activities and races: try all 9 activity types, gold all 42 shooting range challenges, win drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, win 20 races, beat Cal at fishing, finish one arcade game, and max Strength with both characters at once. Raise Focus early; it makes Gunslinger and The Shootist far easier.
roadmap.title: Activities & races

roadmap.description: Collections and scanning: 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 100 vehicles scanned, and full map exploration. Meditating as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice, and scanning passing traffic on a busy street is the fastest way to find vehicles.
roadmap.title: Collections & scanning

roadmap.description: Robberies and fencing: jewelry stores undetected, 5 bank vaults, armored trucks, one illegal operation per gang, the Kingpin Bowling haul, the showroom Banshee smash, laundering $250,000 in marked bills, spending $100,000, buying all 8 garages and registering 10 vehicles. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each and fund the shopping and garage trophies.
roadmap.title: Robberies & fencing

roadmap.description: Clean up the 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion): 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets and the rest. 15 trophies pop automatically along this road. Platinum estimates differ by source: about 200 hours per PowerPyx, about 300 hours per PushSquare.
roadmap.title: 100% checklist cleanup → Platinum

save_strategy.description: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so manual saves are the only safety net. Save at the start and end of every chapter (10 saves), and rotate the remaining 5 slots during free-roam cleanup. Never overwrite a chapter save with a late-game save. Save manually BEFORE the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, so the balcony meditation can be redone if you skip it.

missables.summary: Only 1 of 55 trophies can be missed. Every other trophy can be finished in free-roam after the story ends.

alternatives: Large bank vaults: up to $205,000 per bank, 8 vaults in total.
Fencing: Randy's Wish List pays the most for stolen cars.

cons.claim: No working infinite-money glitch exists right now; most money-glitch videos are fake, reusing old GTA Online footage.
cons.source: afleurdenet — Starter Car & Fast Money Guide

cons.claim: As of 18 Nov, no outlet had reported a working GTA 6 money glitch or duplication glitch.

how_it_works: Enter the red Apollo Aggregates warehouse (red barn), east of Hamlet, South Vice-Dale County, north of Key Lento.
In the back office, take the cocaine from the desk and open the safe. Fill the first stash bag.
In the middle area, take the second stash bag from an open van and fill it with cocaine from other vans, including outside.
Store BOTH stash bags in the trunk of a personal vehicle.
Pause, Game, Save Game on a separate manual slot.
Load that save: the warehouse loot respawns while the bags in the trunk stay.
Repeat, then sell at Brian's Lockup, south-west of Key Lento (keypad code 7700).
apollo_warehouse.label: REPORTED — not fully verified
apollo_warehouse.location: Apollo Aggregates red warehouse, east of Hamlet, South Vice-Dale County, north of Key Lento
apollo_warehouse.phishing_warning: Never enter PSN, Xbox or Rockstar credentials on any third-party cash generator site. Those sites are phishing; the real glitch, if it works, needs no login at all.

pros.claim: Works in the launch version; about $8,640 per loop, first loop about $11,000-$11,280.
Reports the same save/reload loot-respawn loop working on 20 Nov.

sources.name: afleurdenet — Starter Car & Fast Money Guide

apollo_warehouse.verdict: Treat as reported, not proven. It can be patched at any time. The legitimate alternatives below pay more per job and cannot be patched away.
apollo_warehouse.warning: Do NOT leave bags on the ground or carry them during the reload; they can disappear. Always store them in the vehicle first.

bank_vault.description: The fastest legitimate endgame money: 8 large bank vaults, up to $205,000 per bank. Funds Little Boxes ($160,000 for 8 garages) and Treat Yo Self ($100,000 spent).

focus_farm.description: Short shooting range loops raise Focus in about 5 seconds per loop. Higher Focus (level 4) makes Gunslinger and The Shootist much easier: longer slow-motion, steadier aim.
focus_farm.value: Focus up in ~5 seconds per loop

train_tunnel.description: The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the best 4-star escape: police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you there. Best for Hot Together and any 4-star getaway.

weapon_discount.description: In the Chapter 1 weapons mission, clerk Andrew at Chuck's Tackle & Shot / Ammu-Nation gives a 50% discount on the Fortune & Son Moreland 850 shotgun ($350 instead of $700) because Jason is ex-military, and the discount is kept if you come back later.
weapon_discount.value: 50% off the Moreland 850 shotgun ($350 instead of $700)

items.detail: v01.002.000 (13 Nov, about 1.07 GB PS5 / 2.18 GB Xbox) and v01.002.001 (16 Nov, about 602.5 MB PS5 / 1.6 GB Xbox). Rockstar published no patch notes for either. Both must be installed before playing.

On the night of 18 Nov, hours before unlock: failed logins, server errors, download problems. Peak about 10,000 reports (US) + about 6,000 (UK). Fixed by Wednesday midday. This was Sony's side, not a bug in the game.
No trophy is glitched and no trophy fails to pop, per PowerPyx. One trophy-adjacent bug exists: A Classic Blitz Play can fail if you rob an armored truck directly (use the bank vault route instead).
As of 18-20 Nov, no outlet had published a verified list of in-game bugs. The game is rated very polished for its size. Target 30 FPS with drops in dense areas; no 60 FPS mode.
items.topic: No verified in-game bug list yet

items.detail: Posts on X claim Rockstar apologized and will fix things on 25 Nov. No support for this exists on any official Rockstar channel. Treat as unverified.

sideA.claim: Personal Best is about reaching maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time.

sideB.claim: Personal Best is a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign.

disagreements.verdict: Follow PowerPyx: max Strength for both characters together. The Strength reading is the majority view and matches the in-game Strength stat.

sideA.claim: Bad Luck, I Guess is possible from Chapter 2, as soon as you can play as Lucia.

sideB.claim: The best lead needs the Dye Pack Jammer, which unlocks in Chapter 3.

disagreements.topic: Bad Luck, I Guess — Chapter 2 or Chapter 3?
disagreements.verdict: Try from Chapter 2 first; if the robbery does not trigger the trophy, wait until Chapter 3 with the Dye Pack Jammer.

sideA.claim: The Apollo warehouse save/reload loop works in the launch version, about $8,640 per loop.

sideB.claim: No working infinite-money glitch exists right now; most money-glitch videos are fake.

disagreements.topic: Apollo warehouse money glitch — works or not?
disagreements.verdict: DISPUTED — 2 sources for, 2 against. Shown as REPORTED with both sides and legitimate alternatives. It can be patched at any time.

sideA.claim: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter by 1, and PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it.

sideB.claim: The balcony meditation is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy.

disagreements.topic: Chapter 1 balcony meditation — required or not?
disagreements.verdict: Unconfirmed, but costless: do the meditation while it is available. Missing it cannot be fixed later.

sideA.claim: The safe route is through the Chapter 4 bank vault mission, which counts as robbing an armored truck.

sideB.claim: The fast route is to block a truck directly, bomb its back door and escape; but the trophy can fail to pop this way.

disagreements.topic: A Classic Blitz Play — safe route or fast route?
disagreements.verdict: Use the bank vault route. The direct-truck bug is reported, so the fast route risks a wasted robbery.

sideA.claim: 100% completion is a soft requirement, about 60% true completion.

sideB.claim: The platinum takes about 300 hours of play.

disagreements.topic: 100% completion — how much work is it really?
disagreements.verdict: Both can be true: the checklist is weighted leniently, but PowerPyx still estimates about 200 hours for the platinum against PushSquare's 300. Budget 200-300 hours.

sideB.claim: Reviewers finished the story in about 50-60 hours.

disagreements.verdict: 60-80 hours is the safer budget for a first playthrough; reviewers rushing the story finished faster.

sideA.claim: Best lead: kick an enemy during a melee drive-by from a motorcycle.

sideB.claim: No source has proven the exact steps as of 21 Nov 2026, 00:30 WIB.

disagreements.topic: Ten Pin — solved or still unknown?
disagreements.verdict: UNKNOWN. The motorcycle kick is a lead, not a confirmed method. Shown honestly as the only unverified trophy (54/55 confirmed).

sideA.claim: Catch Me If You Can is one of the hidden trophies.

sideB.claim: Challenging Tank is one of the hidden trophies.

disagreements.topic: The 16th hidden non-story trophy — which one?
disagreements.verdict: Unidentified. 28 hidden is confirmed (12 story + 16 non-story), but only 15 non-story hidden are pinned down. Neither candidate is marked hidden in this guide.

sideA.claim: The final mission is Starting From Zero.

sideB.claim: Other sources do not name the final mission explicitly.

disagreements.topic: Final mission name — Starting From Zero?
disagreements.verdict: Shown as the final mission (Chapter 5) without insisting on the name; PowerPyx also names Starting From Zero as the last Chapter 4 mission.

sideA.claim: The UFO event needs Chapter 1 finished, after 02:00, alone.

sideB.claim: The spawn is random; leave and return if the flashing car is not there.

disagreements.topic: The Truth Is Out There — fixed event or random spawn?
disagreements.verdict: Both agree on after Chapter 1 and after 02:00. The spawn itself is random, so repeat visits are expected.

sideA.claim: Stick Fiddler only needs 1 arcade game finished, so it is separate from 100%.

sideB.claim: The 100% checklist counts playing all 4 video games, so finishing one game is part of the checklist.

disagreements.topic: Stick Fiddler — separate from 100% or partly covered?
disagreements.verdict: PARTIAL. One finished game pops the trophy; the checklist wants all four games played.
